task_description: Give Lya real file access on the backend in mode Desk: make the Hermes bridge multi-turn (OpenAI-style function calling) and implement read_file, write_file and patch_file tools jailed to WORKSPACE_DIR, so the teacher can say 'update this file' and Lya can request it, read it and complete it. Mode Desk gets two sub-modes (copie/insertion and mise à jour directe, the latter showing the working file at the top of the panel). Must degrade silently to today's single-turn behaviour if Hermes ignores the tools parameter, must not touch mode Lya or mode Pi, and must not remove the v1.9.1 prompt inlining fallback. Branch: feat/hermes-file-tools.

verification.summary: Orchestrator-run final pass on feat/hermes-file-tools. Backend: go build, go vet, gofmt -l (no output), go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=90s all green (internal/api, internal/bridge, internal/export). Frontend: 8 vitest files / 90 tests passing (baseline was 79) and npm run build ok. git diff vs main is empty for backend/internal/bridge/pi.go, frontend/src/components/LyaChat.tsx and version.json. Test quality reviewed by reading the new tests: the backend tests drive real WebSocket jobs against a scripted fake Hermes that records every decoded request body, assert on files actually created/read/patched in t.TempDir(), on the role:"tool" messages fed back in the follow-up request, on the declared tools array, on request counts (loop cap = exactly 8, degradation = exactly 1) and on file_changed events; the frontend tests drive real WS messages and assert rendered DOM including the working-file banner's position above the conversation. Each feature was additionally mutation-verified by its sub-agent, and one surviving mutant in safePath was found and closed. Docker build skipped: the deployment images are built by the GitHub Actions CI, not required for this change.
verification.unverifiable: Whether the real Hermes gateway forwards the OpenAI tools parameter upstream cannot be tested from this sandbox (cluster unreachable). The loop degrades to the previous single-turn behaviour when no tool_calls come back, and every job logs one greppable line 'hermes: tool_calls supported=true|false (mode=... deskMode=... loops=... toolCalls=...)' to settle it from production logs.
